thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: GPU-MEM-PRESSURE (P1) — pool=west2a; impacted hosts ~3; alert_id=pd_3157890000

alice: acked (on-call). I'm taking it. :rotating_light:

charlie: seeing repeated CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL on infer-rtg-3-07, logs show `cudaMalloc` failing with small allocs. snippet:
```
E CUDA: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
host=infer-rtg-3-07 pid=8421 alloc=2199023256
2026-03-15T02:40:10Z
```

alice: copy. kicking off quick mitigation plan — drain/evacuate bad host, fallback smaller model variant for in-flight requests, reduce batch sizes.

eve: evac request queued for infer-rtg-3-07 (drain + migrate pods). autoscaler may take 2-5m to replace. zone capacity looks thin.

diana: any customer impact yet? watching /v1/generate 503s.

charlie: short window of elevated 503s for a handful of customers — acme-corp shows spike ~02:40-02:42 UTC (0.8% of their 1m QPS).

alice: toggling fallback: route west2a -> model:small-quant for affected hosts. also toggling REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=0 to reduce prefetch pressure.

ben: joining. what's the state of replacements and drains?

alice: eviction started: `/ops evac --pool west2a --host infer-rtg-3-07 --reason "OOM spike"` — pods are cordoned, traffic shifted. batch_size lowered from 8 -> 4 for west2a via configmap patch.

charlie: applied config changes:
```
kubectl set env ds/infer-worker REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=0 -n inference
kubectl patch configmap inference-batch -n inference --patch '{"data":{"batch_size":"4"}}'
```
memory usage on infer-rtg-3-07 dropped ~30% after env change and drain. still seeing fragmentation on infer-rtg-3-05 and -3-09.

eve: scheduling drains for infer-rtg-3-05 and infer-rtg-3-09 now, ETA ~3m. pre-warming replacements in parallel.

diana: pinged acme-corp SRE with ETA and short summary: "brief elevated 503s, mitigations in progress, monitoring for stabilization."

alice: handing off to ben in 10m — leaving notes in thread: reduced batch_size, disabled kv prefetch, model fallback applied, evacuated infer-rtg-3-07.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert escalated to second on-call (ben) — escalation time 3157890065.

ben: ben here, taking over. good work. i'll coordinate with infra for aggressive preemptive drains and watch for regressions.

charlie: suggest follow-ups: add metric for "gpu_slab_free_ratio" and an alert on sustained fragmentation > 60% for 5m. also add auto-drain when alloc_fail_rate > 0.5% for 2m.

eve: noted — infra will schedule a runbook change. for now drains in progress, replacements coming up.

diana: customer update sent. they acknowledged, asked for postmortem.

alice: leaving: please escalate to platform if we see repeat in the next 24h. logs + commands saved at https://internal/runbooks/gpu-mem-frag-2026-03-15 (internal). :white_check_mark:

ben: monitoring for 30m. will close PD if no new alloc fails and 503 rate returns to baseline.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved (auto) — cleared at 3157890120.

charlie: post-incident action items (short):
- tune prefetch heuristic to consider free slab ratio
- implement fragmentation metric + alert
- add node-level auto-drain threshold to runbook
assigning to infra/sre for next sprint.

diana: postmortem scheduled with customer comms. SLA impact estimated: none (below threshold), but we will follow up.

ben: closing handoff. ping me if it flares back. :thumbsup:
